name: Cinfenine
summary: Cinfenine (INNTooltip International Nonproprietary Name) is a drug described as an antidepressant and coronary vasodilator which was never marketed. It was first described in the literature by 1970.

pharmacology.text: The drug is similar in chemical structure to the modafinil derivative and atypical dopamine reuptake inhibitor JJC8-016, as well as to the antihistamine and anticholinergic diphenhydramine and derivatives of diphenhydramine like ebastine.

uses.text: Cinfenine (INN) is a drug described as an antidepressant and coronary vasodilator which was never marketed.

fact.en: It carries a diphenylmethyl group, two benzene rings on one carbon, the same building block found in diphenhydramine and modafinil and in many other drugs that act on the brain.
fact.zh: 它帶有二苯甲基，也就是同一個碳上接兩個苯環的結構，這個基本單元也出現在苯海拉明、莫達非尼以及許多其他作用於大腦的藥物中。
fact.zhHans: 它带有二苯甲基，也就是同一个碳上接两个苯环的结构，这个基本单元也出现在苯海拉明、莫达非尼以及许多其他作用于大脑的药物中。
